verdict.rationale: Linear documents an official TypeScript SDK that exposes the GraphQL schema through strongly typed models and operations, with install docs and code samples. Its source and schema live in the official linear/linear repo. Supporting developer resources include an introspectable GraphQL API, an Apollo Studio explorer and a published deprecation policy. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in languages beyond TypeScript, in-depth SDK reference coverage (pagination, errors, agent-specific helpers), and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
